steps.title: Enter on West Temple
steps.detail: East doors, Level 1. 200 South is the other entrance — ignore it. You’re in the East Lobby with the 150s corridor on your right.
steps.altitudeHint: You are on Level 1. Room 255 is one level up.

steps.title: Walk north along the 150s
steps.detail: Keep rooms 150–154 on your right. Head toward the 155 stack at the northeast corner — that’s the column under 255.

steps.title: Find the 155 / 255 / 355 stack
steps.detail: Room 155 is the lower room in this vertical stack. 255 sits directly above it on the mezzanine. Do not enter 155.
steps.altitudeHint: Same column, different altitude. You still need +1 floor.

steps.title: Take the east escalators up
steps.detail: Escalators are in the East Lobby, immediately west of 155. Ride up one level to the mezzanine. Elevators behind the escalators work too.
steps.altitudeHint: Going from Level 1 → Level 2. 255 is not on this floor.

steps.title: You’re on the mezzanine
steps.detail: Step off. Room 255 is immediately to your right — same footprint as 155 below. Look for the stacked 155/255/355 plaque.
steps.altitudeHint: Now on Level 2. 355 is still above you; 155 is directly below.

steps.title: Slide into 255
steps.detail: Doors on the west wall. Talk is already in progress — enter along the back row. Crowd take: standing room, sit along the rear.
